title: Skip link goes nowhere and several pages lack a main landmark or heading
steps: node scratch skiplink check over 9 pages; keyboard: Tab, Enter on /landing.
expected: 'Skip to main content' moves focus to the page's main region; each page has one <main> and one <h1>.
actual: Every page renders the skip link to #main-content, but no element has that id (AppLayout's <main> only has data-page-guide="main-content"). Login, register, forgot-password, service agreement and public showroom pages have no <main>; the public showroom page has no <h1>.
impact: Keyboard and screen-reader users must tab through the full header and sidebar on every page.
fix: Add id="main-content" tabIndex={-1} to the <main> in AppLayout; wrap AuthLayout, the legal page and the public showroom in <main id="main-content">; give the showroom an <h1> (business name).
